context.decisionSummary: Owner-directed guerrilla marksman redesign: one soft hood, dust scarf, cloth field tunic and half-cloak, leather bracer, one back quiver with three arrows and one recurve bow. No helmet, plate cuirass, pauldrons or second equipment pass. Crown affiliation is a small cloth armband; leaders have sewn rank marks. Follow-up: owner said the redesign was a lot better, but requested removal of the decorative line between the feet, which looked like a rope.
